title: Templars and the secrets of time travel

tellings.quote: Templars supposedly had the secrets of time travel you know if you read the Umberto eeko Fuko pendulum

plain: The Knights Templar, a medieval order of warrior monks, are supposed to have held the secrets of time travel. Michels mentions this himself, saying "if you read the Umberto Eco Foucault's Pendulum," pointing to the novel by the Italian writer Umberto Eco, which is built around legends of hidden Templar knowledge.
